definitions.gloss: conceding no points; holding the opponent scoreless
definitions.explanation: Not allowing the other side to score, in baseball, soccer and other sports.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先発|せんぱつ}{投手|とうしゅ}→先発投手：26597_senpatsutoushu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{七回|ななかい}{無失点|むしってん}だった。
examples.english: The starting pitcher gave up no runs over seven innings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{守備|しゅび}→守備：15509_shubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{良|よ}く→良い：02350_yoi⟧、⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{無失点|むしってん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: Thanks to good defense, they finished the first half without conceding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{無失点|むしってん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}えて→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧、⟦{完封|かんぷう}→完封：06543_kanpuu⟧{勝|が}ち⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They held the other team scoreless to the end and won by a shutout.

notes:
USAGE:
⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (no) + ⟦{失点|しってん}→失点：19150_shitten⟧ (points or runs conceded).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無失点|むしってん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to hold the opponent scoreless
- ～⟦{回|かい}→回：00957_kai⟧{無失点|むしってん}: scoreless over ~ innings

WATCH OUT:
{無得点|むとくてん} is the opposite situation: failing to score yourself. A team with {無失点|むしってん} allowed no points; a team with {無得点|むとくてん} made none.
